settings.label: Calendar feed URL
settings.help: A public .ics link from Google Calendar, Outlook, iCloud, Nextcloud, etc. webcal:// links work too.

settings.label: Days of history
settings.help: How far back to read the feed. A theme drawing a month needs the days already gone, not just the ones coming.

settings.label: Days ahead
settings.help: How far forward to read the feed. This doesn't control how many events get shown — that's the theme's call.

settings.label: Refresh every
settings.help: Minutes between downloads of the feed. Note that Google only regenerates its exported feeds every few hours, so asking more often than that won't get you fresher events.
